read.thesis: Carrier's commercial HVAC backlog up mid-teens and Americas orders up ~40% point to capacity-led growth, but 2025 guide relies on ~10% refrigerant price realisation and a flat-to-down European market.

utilisation.quote: we basically stood up a brand-new facility in North America for commercial HVAC

capex.quote: We're maxing out our Charlotte, North Carolina facility. So with the capacity that we've now built, we have the ability to significantly increase our Charlotte output probably by about 50%.

triggers.label: New N. America commercial plant built in 7-8 months
triggers.quote: we basically stood up a brand-new facility in North America for commercial HVAC, something that would normally take maybe 18 to 24 months, we did in about 7 to 8 months.

triggers.label: Global commercial HVAC backlog up mid-teens
triggers.quote: Our global commercial HVAC backlog is up mid-teens versus last year, positioning us for another year of double-digit growth in 2025 in that business.

triggers.label: 454B refrigerant price ~10% realised
triggers.quote: And of that 454B, we expect a 10% -- to realize a 10% price increase.

triggers.label: Distributor inventory not too high; ~$75-100M prebuy
triggers.quote: So look, inventory in the channel, not too high, movement goods.

triggers.label: Europe volume flat to down mid-single digits
triggers.quote: we assume that market volume will be flat to down mid-single digits.

guidance.quote: We expect mid-single-digit organic growth and reported sales of between $22.5 billion and $23 billion.
We expect adjusted EPS to be between $2.95 and $3.05, up 17% at the midpoint.
we intend to repurchase about $3 billion in shares.
Total company adjusted operating margin is expected to be up about 100 basis points compared to 2024
we think it will double. So we're looking at $1 billion of data center sales this year.
We think that with the actions that we've taken and will take, that will get to the mid-teens this year.

red_flags.label: Mexico 25% tariff exposure not mitigated
red_flags.quote: do we have everything figured out if there's a 25% tariff in Mexico. We don't have it geared out exactly yet.

evasions.quote: Whether or not everyone in the industry is at that level, it's hard for me to say.
We do not have perfect visibility into the inventory in our dealer channel.
